description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
vibe: Deterministic task runners, disciplined formatting, and modular consistency.
highlights: Preserve the platform architecture; keep deployment-specific adapters isolated. Detailed source synchronization records are maintained locally and are not required for community changes. The original local workflow runtime lives in `local/`; follow `local/AGENTS.md` there. Never copy private deployment files, credentials, staff data, or internal infrastructure into this repository.
本文件面向所有在仓库内工作的 AI agent 与人类贡献者，约定 repo 层与 handler 层的结构规则。
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
